nom: Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser with Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts and better control of shine and clogged pores with regular use, generally using it once daily to avoid over-drying.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who usually react to face washes, report no burning or irritation and appreciate the fragrance-free formula, though a couple still felt a slight sting or tightness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it targets oily T-zone areas like sebaceous filaments without over-drying the rest of the face.

concerns.blemishes: The great majority of reviewers report visibly fewer and less severe breakouts within one to a few weeks, including hormonal and teen acne; a small number say they saw no real change in their acne.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report it leaves skin clean without the tight, stripped feeling other acne washes cause, but a substantial minority say it does dry out their skin, especially with twice-daily use, and pair it with a moisturizer afterward.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report gradual fading of post-acne marks and scars over weeks of consistent use, though a couple say they saw no change to their existing scars.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily T-zones report it helps clear sebaceous filaments and reduce shine without worsening their oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Lathers well from a small amount
Menthyl lactate can sting or tingle near the eyes
Clear gel texture rinses off easily
No physical exfoliating beads despite exfoliation claims

extraits.texte: I enjoy Neutrogena products, but this one was a let-down. This product did not sud up as a soap, definitely doesn't have any beads or reason to say it "exfoliates". Left my skin very dry, and after two weeks of giving it a chance, I didn't see any change.

Disclaimer: Not a skincare professional, just a skincare nerd. On paper, this product is perfect for my skin needs, as someone with oily, acne-prone skin. Upon first use, it seemed like I would love this product, but that quickly changed when I started to feel a tingling sensation. The culprit was menthyl lactate, a menthol derivative which you've probably experienced in a plumping gloss, and it gives a cooling sensation. Unfortunately, it's extremely uncomfortable on the face, especially if you get it near the delicate skin of your lips and eyes. This burns if it gets too close to your eyes, and it lingers for a couple minutes This wouldn't happen often, but for some reason this cleanser is very runny once it's on the skin even though it lathers quite thickly. If you enjoy the "cooling" feeling, great! But personally, this really hinders my experience. I would love this otherwise, but that sensation + the running of the cleanser doesn't make for a positive cleansing experience.

I've been using this Neutrogena Evenly Clear cleanser for a little bit now and I really like how it feels. Since I have super sensitive skin, my face usually tends to burn with face washes, especially ones that have a scent. This one has a very slight floral scent that doesn't smell bad at all, and while I did feel a little sting sensation, it honestly wasn't too bad. I think it mostly depends on if I shave my face right before using it or if I use the wash first. The texture is a clear gel that lathers up super well, so you don't need much to spread over your whole face. It feels like it's deeply cleaning my pores and helping with marks without leaving my skin feeling totally stripped. The pump is also really convenient and works smoothly. I'm knocking off one star just because of that slight stinging I felt, but if you don't have sensitive skin I'd definitely recommend it!

The Neutrogena Acne Cleanser exceeded my expectations. Usually products with salicylic acid are harsh on my skin,. This face wash didn't leave it dry or irritated. It left me feeling clean and fresh. The most important thing about it was getting rid of bigger pores in my T-zone and breakouts. I have combination skin and it targeted the problem areas well.

Wow to Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Cleanser, I have found my Holy Grail with this product. I have hormonal acne and hyperpigmentation. While using this cleanser my face did not purge! It was gentle on my skin but strong enough to eliminate that oily feeling after use and my skin did not feel dry. The salicylic acid and PHA exfoliant cleaned out my pores which helped prevent future breakouts. I was extremely impressed with this cleanser and have already recommended it to my friends. My post acne marks have diminished immensely and this cleanser is fragrance free which is great for sensitive skin girlies like me. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

This face wash worked great for me! I have very sensitive skin and this did not cause any irritation or redness after using once daily for a few weeks. My skin does look more smooth, and I have not had any breakouts since I started using it. I love that. There is no fragrance, the pump dispenser has worked well for me and the way lathers feels very nice on my skin. Does not cause any excessive dryness either. Would recommend!

Overall I am very pleased with this cleanser. A little goes a long way, and it doesn't leave my skin feeling overly tight or stripped. I struggle with sebaceous filaments around my chin, and cheek. It was nice use a cleaner that was suitable for daily use and still has exfoliating ingredients. I would definitely reccomend to others
